 Don’t Miss Your Chance to Nab a Nintendo Switch 2 for $469 With This Early Black Friday Doorbuster
 Woot has new Nintendo Switch 2 consoles available at a discount, but stock is limited, so act fast.
 Adrian Marlow 
 Writer II
 Adrian is a deals writer on the Commerce team at CNET.… Read full bio 
 Adrian Marlow
 Writer II
 Read full bio 
 November 10, 2026, 9:32 am ET
 1 min read 
 Nintendo/CNET 
 Save $31 : Following a price hike in September, the standard Nintendo Switch 2 comes in at a hefty $500 . However, right now Woot is offering a $31 discount that drops the price to $469 . This deal is limited to one console per customer, and while it says the deal is available through the end of the month, the caveat is that it’s only while supplies last. Given this console’s popularity, I expect stock to run dry much faster than that, so get your order in soon if you’re interested. 
 $469 (Original price, post-hike: $500) 
 Nintendo Switch 2 
 $469 at Woot 
 If you haven’t given the Switch 2 a spin, now’s your chance. This console won our Editors’ Choice award and is our pick for the best overall gaming handheld of 2026. Play your favorite games on a 7.9-inch, 1080p screen, an upgrade over the first model. It has 256GB of internal storage, also better than the original, but it’s still expandable with microSD Express cards (sold separately).
 Our reviewer, Scott Stein, appreciated its large display and thin design, as well as its notably better graphics. He also enjoyed the magnetic-attaching controllers. If you’ve been holding off on getting one because of rising electronics prices, this deal is for you.
 More from CNET
 Be sure to check out our full coverage of early Black Friday deals for more excellent offers. 
 $469 at Woot 
 Alternatives you might like
 If you’re a fan of The Legend of Zelda, you may want to try your hand at getting the Zelda-themed special-edition Nintendo Switch 2, celebrating the series’ 40th anniversary. It sold out during preorders, but now that it’ ha’s been released, we’re tracking restocks both in-store and online.
